What your yard is entitled to.
Pour une structure de moins de 250 salar: For organisations with fewer than 250 employees, in the first year of the contract: €5,000 for a level 3 or 4 diploma (CAP, bac pro, BPJEPS…), €4,500 for level 5, €2,000 for level 6 or 7.
Versée chaque mois par l'ASP, une fois l: Paid monthly by the ASP once the apprentice's pay has been declared (DSN). The contract must start before 1 January 2027.
Pour les jeunes de 6 à 17 ans sous condi: For young people aged 6 to 17 subject to means testing, students on grants and young people with disabilities up to 30.
Les 50 € servent à payer l'adhésion ou l: The €50 helps pay for membership or a licence in a sports organisation. 2026-2027 season: applications possible until 31 December 2026.
Pour les associations loi 1901 d'Île-de-: For non-profit associations (loi 1901) in Île-de-France (sport included): support for running costs (communication, small equipment…) or for a new project. In Essonne, priority to small associations (fewer than 2 employees) and to the south of the department.
Conditions : au moins un an d'existence,: Conditions: at least one year of existence, a bank account in its name, the signed republican commitment contract, and accounts approved at a general meeting — which is what "My accounts" helps you prepare.
La campagne 2026 de l'Essonne a fermé le: The 2026 Essonne campaign closed on 11 March 2026: the next one usually opens in January.
Subvention de l'Agence du Sport: Grant from the Agence du Sport
Subventions de l'Agence nationale du Spo: Grants from the Agence nationale du Sport paid to affiliated clubs through their federation (for us, the FFE), for a project: welcoming new audiences, health, coaching…
En 2026, la plupart des fédérations ont: In 2026, most federations opened their campaign between March and April. The FFE's conditions for equestrian sport could not be found online: check with the FFE or the regional committee before spring.
Fonds de la filière équine qui soutient: Horse industry fund supporting investment and development projects (equipment, facilities, collective projects).
Les conditions et le calendrier 2026 n'o: The 2026 conditions and timetable could not be found online: check on the Fonds Éperon website or with the Conseil des chevaux d'Île-de-France.
Modèles de contrats et d'affichages obli: Model contracts and mandatory notices, labour law and payroll questions for equestrian establishments.
Déclaration de détenteur, identification: Keeper declaration, horse identification, holding register guide.
Accompagne les projets de la filière équ: Supports horse industry projects in Île-de-France and gives its opinion on some funding.
Montants et dates vérifiés le 6 novembre: Amounts and dates checked on 6 November 2026, except grants marked "To check". They change often: always check the source before applying. Hype has no commercial agreement with these organisations.
